text.tspan: session expired or invalid: refresh or log in again

svg.text: → refused again even after 3 refreshes: Disconnected
Why refresh first, then connect? The Socket.IO door guard only looks at the 15-minute wristband, and doesn't know you just clicked Log out in another tab.
/auth/refresh checks the session in the database, so a tab that has logged out doesn't connect again.
